fullPassage: There is a tendency, once the dust of an emergency has settled down, to seek the reduction of famine vulnerability primarily in enhanced economic growth, or the revival of the rural economy, or the diversification of economic activities. The potential contribution of greater economic success, if it involves vulnerable groups, cannot be denied. At the same time, it is important to recognize that, no matter how fast they grow, countries where a large part of the population derive their livelihood from uncertain sources cannot hope to prevent famines without specialized entitlement protection mechanisms involving direct public intervention. Rapid growth of the economy in Botswana, or of the agricultural sector in Kenya, or of food production in Zimbabwe, explains at best only a small part of their success in preventing recurrent threats of famine. The real achievements of these countries lie in having provided direct public support to their populations in times of crisis.

det.tip: 요지 = direct public intervention > economic growth

ch: 기근 예방에는 경제 성장보다 직접적 공적 개입이 더 중요하다.

questions.passage: There is a tendency, once the dust of an emergency has settled down, to seek the reduction of famine vulnerability primarily in enhanced economic growth, or the revival of the rural economy, or the diversification of economic activities. The potential contribution of greater economic success, if it involves vulnerable groups, cannot be denied. At the same time, it is important to recognize that, no matter how fast they grow, countries where a large part of the population derive their livelihood from uncertain sources cannot hope to prevent famines without specialized entitlement protection mechanisms involving direct public intervention. Rapid growth of the economy in Botswana, or of the agricultural sector in Kenya, or of food production in Zimbabwe, explains at best only a small part of their success in preventing recurrent threats of famine. The real achievements of these countries lie in having __________ to their populations in times of crisis.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 영어로 쓰시오.
"이 나라들의 진정한 성과는 위기 시 국민에게 __________ 한 것에 있다."
[조건] (1) provided, direct, public, support를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 4단어로 쓸 것
(영어로) (4단어)

det.korean: 원문: 'having provided direct public support' — 직접적 공적 지원을 제공한.
det.analysis: provided + direct + public + support = 4단어
det.tip: provided direct public support (직접적 공적 지원을 제공한)
